verdict.rationale: mParticle's docs have a 'Client SDKs' section, and the Events API reference says the client SDKs set the environment flag via isDevelopmentMode, so official SDKs exist. A developer's account of routing app data through mParticle adds indirect hands-on corroboration. The OpenAPI spec for generating helper SDKs is only a building block and earns no credit. Missing for 10: an enumerated list of supported SDK languages and platforms, any documentation of server-side or Platform/Profile API SDKs, SDK reference depth or versioning details, and stronger independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
